run_coco_extract: run coco_extract to preprocess COCO dataset keypoints and save to npz file
run_coco_extract_val: run coco_extract with train_val set to val to preprocess COCO validation dataset
run_coco_extract_with_foot: run coco_extract with bWithCOCOFoot enabled to include foot keypoints from CMU foot annotations
loadFoot: load foot keypoints from CMU foot annotations JSON file and filter by complete foot data
review_coco_extract: review the coco_extract function to understand COCO 2014 dataset preprocessing and npz output format
